page_title: BAY 3-2 EIN | Bayern Munich v Eintracht Frankfurt 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+5' Good chance! Nathaniel Brown laid the ball off to Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
90+5' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
90+4' Substitution. Joshua Kimmich makes his way off the pitch and Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
90+4' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Michael Olise will be replaced by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
90+2' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
86' 3 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 3:2.
83' None of the Eintracht Frankfurt players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
83' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
78' That's the end of the game for Jamal Musiala, who is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
77' It will be a substitution. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is ready to enter the pitch as Aleksandar Pavlovic walks off.
77' The game has come to an end for Oscar Hojlund. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' Albert Riera has decided to make a change. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ellyes Skhiri.
77' 3 - 1 Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) scores from the penalty spot after firing the ball into the bottom left corner to give the goalkeeper no chance!
76' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' It’s a PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt after the VAR review!
75' Referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Eintracht Frankfurt. Let’s see what happens!
74' The attendance is 75000.
72' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
71' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

68' 3 - 0 Joshua Kimmich passes to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 3:0.

61' OFF THE POST! Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
61' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Bayern Munich win a corner.
60' The substitution is prepared. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ritsu Doan.
60' Albert Riera has decided to substitute Ayoube Amaimouni and he is replaced by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt).
60' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mahmoud Dahoud.

59' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Kaua Santos shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
59' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Kaua Santos.
55' A great run from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
50' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch after Alphonso Davies signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
49' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

47' What an opportunity! Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
43' A corner kick by Eintracht Frankfurt is thwarted by the well prepared Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich).
43' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Eintracht Frankfurt force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Jamal Musiala, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

39' Great solo effort by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Jonas Urbig is alert and denies him.
39' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

38' That's unlucky! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is able to continue to play.
30' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
30' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
25' Luis Diaz does a good job setting up Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
20' 2 - 0 GOAL! The corner comes over and Josip Stanisic wins a simple header before Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) nods the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
20' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
20' The corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
19' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
16' 1 - 0 Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
15' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
15' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
15' The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.

15' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Tobias Reichel who sees an offensive foul.
11' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared away by the defence.

10' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
10' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
8' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) produces a cunning chipped pass for Michael Olise, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tobias Reichel.
